limitations: Discovery surfaces supplied leads only; included observations rely on recovered upstream source URLs.
No Reality Check packets were created or mutated.
AP and Reuters items are retained as wire reporting; Guardian material is retained as attributed reporting; force posture and official claims are not independently verified operating fact.
Model-impact labels are provisional pressure readings against inherited repository state, not policy recommendations, forecast resolutions, political comparisons, or public factual adjudication.

morning_judgment: August 30 keeps the inherited coercive-carrier model under pressure rather than replacing it. The Ukraine/Russia lane moved further toward energy infrastructure, drone adaptation, and bargaining leverage; the Iran/Hormuz lane remained a sanctions, hardship, and managed-transit problem rather than a clean settlement; U.S. naval rotation stress became visible through the Lincoln return after an unusually long Middle East deployment; and Canada-Europe alignment stayed live as a middle-power response to U.S. tariff pressure. The NATO drone-training item is retained as the outlier because it shows Ukraine-derived battlefield adaptation migrating into allied force design without itself resolving the Russia/Iran coercion baseline.
